intake.failed: Order intake could not be read
intake.axes: Booked per week or month; orders booked
intake.emptyHint: An order counts here on the day it is booked, once confirmed. Pick a longer period.

kv.ordersHint: Confirmed in the period; never a cancelled one
kv.piecesHint: Garment lines; fee lines have none
kv.valueHint: Net, before VAT, at the orders' value now

intake.chartLabel: Order intake: {measure} per bar and orders booked
intake.captionValue: The bars are the net value booked (split into the largest groups when split); the line counts the orders booked.
intake.captionPieces: The bars are the pieces booked (split into the largest groups when split); the line counts the orders booked.
intake.bucketsLabel: Weeks or months: each opens its orders
intake.definition: Booked = confirmed: an order waiting for a yes counts once confirmed, on its order date; a cancelled order and a return's replacement never count. An order split off another counts on the day its first order was booked.
intake.styleNote: By style an order counts once in each style it holds; its pieces and value are the style's lines.

backlog.hint: Confirmed and not shipped, on {today}: every open size at its promise now.
backlog.failed: The backlog could not be read
backlog.axes: Open pieces per promise week; value or orders
backlog.emptyHint: Every confirmed order has shipped, or none is open.

kv.lateHint: Pieces whose promise is before today
kv.valueHint: The open pieces' share of each line's net value

backlog.chartLabel: Backlog: open pieces per promise week, late pieces apart
backlog.caption: Late pieces (a promise before today) are red. A week before this one holds only late pieces.
backlog.weeksLabel: Promise weeks: each opens its open sizes
backlog.definition: The open orders (confirmed, in production, ready, partly shipped): each size ordered less what shipped, a line closed short left out, at the promise now (the promise history, else the date typed on the line or order). Promise dates are planning's; this report never changes them.

returns.hint: Return lines asked for from {from} to {to}.

returns.axes: Pieces by reason; style by size
returns.outside: Returns are not in your role
returns.outsideBody: This panel counts customer returns: it needs the right to see them.
returns.emptyHint: A return counts on the day it was asked for; turned down and cancelled ones never count.

kv.rateOutside: Shipments are counted with the right to see orders
kv.rateHint: Of {shipped} pieces shipped in the period

returns.noGroups: Reasons are shown one by one: reason groups are not kept yet.
returns.definition: Each return line counts the pieces asked back, with the customer's reason (the return reason list of Sales settings). The style, colour and size are the order line's it names.

drill.noSteps: No next one: this opens a whole group or period.

listHint.backlog: The open orders, searched by the customer when this is one customer's: the list takes no promise week.
listHint.returns: Every return, searched by the customer when this is one customer's: the list takes no reason or period.

drill.more: The first {shown} of {count} rows are shown; the file has them all.
